CustomField.label: Callouts JSON
CustomField.description: JSON array of gap patterns in the shape defined by ma-migrator capabilities/schema/capability.schema.json -- pattern, status, severity, category, issue, gloss, workaround, manual_steps -- plus verification_required. Reusing that shape verbatim is the point: a callout typed by a consultant and a callout lifted from a real platform manifest render identically, so a reader never has to ask which kind they are looking at.
